sentences.ar: إجا السبت، والدنيا مشمسة، وكل الأولاد برا بيلعبوا.
sentences.en: Saturday came, the world was sunny, and all the boys were outside playing.

sentences.ar: وتوم واقف قدام سور طويل، بإيده فرشاية ودلو دهان أبيض.
sentences.en: And Tom stood in front of a long fence, with a brush and a bucket of white paint in his hand.

sentences.ar: السور طوله تلاتين متر، وعالي، وكله لازم يندهن.
sentences.en: The fence was thirty metres long, and high, and all of it had to be painted.

sentences.ar: دهن خط، وتطلع عاللي ضل، وقعد على الأرض.
sentences.en: He painted one stroke, looked at what remained, and sat down on the ground.

sentences.ar: الحياة صارت بلا معنى.
sentences.en: Life had become meaningless.

sentences.ar: فكر يدفع لولد يدهن بداله، بس ما معه غير حجر وخيط وحبة زجاج.
sentences.en: He thought of paying a boy to paint instead of him, but he had nothing but a stone, a string and a marble.

sentences.ar: وبهاللحظة، إجت له فكرة.
sentences.en: And in that moment, an idea came to him.

sentences.ar: فكرة عظيمة.
sentences.en: A great idea.

sentences.ar: أخد الفرشاية، ورجع يدهن، وهو هادي وسعيد.
sentences.en: He took the brush, and went back to painting, calm and happy.

sentences.ar: وبعد شوي، مر بن روجرز، وبإيده تفاحة، وبيقلد سفينة.
sentences.en: And a little later, Ben Rogers passed by, an apple in his hand, imitating a steamboat.

sentences.ar: قال بن: يا توم، شو، مسكوك؟
sentences.en: Ben said: hey Tom, what, they caught you?

sentences.ar: لازم تشتغل؟
sentences.en: You have to work?

sentences.ar: توم ما رد.
sentences.en: Tom did not answer.

sentences.ar: ضل يدهن، ويبعد شوي، ويتطلع عالسور زي الفنان.
sentences.en: He kept painting, stepping back a little, looking at the fence like an artist.

sentences.ar: قال توم: شغل؟
sentences.en: Tom said: work?

sentences.ar: هاد مش شغل.
sentences.en: This is not work.

sentences.ar: هاد دهان سور.
sentences.en: This is painting a fence.

sentences.ar: وقال: كم ولد بتفكر بيقدر يدهن سور؟
sentences.en: And he said: how many boys do you think can paint a fence?

sentences.ar: واحد بالألف؟
sentences.en: One in a thousand?

sentences.ar: بن وقف، وتطلع عالسور، وبطل ياكل التفاحة.
sentences.en: Ben stopped, looked at the fence, and stopped eating the apple.

sentences.ar: قال: يا توم، خليني أدهن شوي.
sentences.en: He said: Tom, let me paint a little.

sentences.ar: قال توم: لا.
sentences.en: Tom said: no.

sentences.ar: الخالة بولي بتهتم كتير بهالسور.
sentences.en: Aunt Polly cares a lot about this fence.

sentences.ar: ما بيقدر أي حدا يدهنه.
sentences.en: Not just anyone can paint it.

sentences.ar: قال بن: بعطيك التفاحة.
sentences.en: Ben said: I give you the apple.

sentences.ar: فكر توم، وقال: طيب.
sentences.en: Tom thought, and said: fine.

sentences.ar: بس انتبه.
sentences.en: But be careful.

sentences.ar: وقعد توم بالظل، ياكل التفاحة، وبن بيدهن بالشمس، وهو مبسوط.
sentences.en: And Tom sat in the shade, eating the apple, while Ben painted in the sun, happy.

sentences.ar: وبعد بن إجا بيلي، ودفع طيارة ورق.
sentences.en: And after Ben came Billy, and paid a kite.

sentences.ar: وبعد بيلي إجا جوني، ودفع فار ميت بخيط.
sentences.en: And after Billy came Johnny, and paid a dead rat on a string.

sentences.ar: ومع المسا، السور كان مدهون تلات مرات، وتوم غني.
sentences.en: And by evening, the fence had been painted three times, and Tom was rich.

sentences.ar: اتناعشر حبة زجاج، ومفتاح، وقطعة طبشور، وقطة بعين وحدة.
sentences.en: Twelve marbles, a key, a piece of chalk, and a cat with one eye.

sentences.ar: وتعلم توم قانون كبير عن الناس.
sentences.en: And Tom learned a big law about people.

sentences.ar: عشان تخلي الواحد يشتهي إشي، خليه صعب.
sentences.en: To make someone want a thing, make it hard to get.
